metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-65. - Type of streets.
content.summary:
Within the city, all streets shall be designated as one of the following types, and
               their type and layout shall conform to that as shown in the city Land Development
               Code and engineering standards adopted in section 82-161 et seq.
(Code 1981, § 30-50; Ord. No. 1432, § 5…
